name: Summer Kitchen, Blainville
lede: In Blainville, north of Montréal, an installer planned a backyard as one outdoor room. Once motorised screens closed the exposed side, two Tungsten heaters were enough where the first calculation called for four.
data: Private home – summer kitchen and terrace
Tungsten Smart-Heat® (2) – electric or gas to confirm
beats: A backyard planned as one outdoor room: a summer kitchen with a Dekton counter, a barbecue, a wood-fired oven, a wood fireplace and motorised screens.
The kitchen and terrace had to be comfortable on cool Quebec evenings, with as little equipment as the space would allow.
Mughet put the screens in before the heaters. With the exposed side closed, two Bromic Tungsten heaters were enough where the first calculation called for four.
